Office is the design and durable-artifact workspace inside Consuelo OS. It coordinates existing tools and scripts; it is not a separate script engine.

## Default workflow

```text
brief
  → choose an Office subskill or template
  → create or edit source
  → validate the result in a browser
  → publish when approved
  → verify the durable route
```

Office currently supports work orders for websites, demos, image briefs, digital e-guides, HTML email, motion frames, and HyperFrames output. `office.listSkills` and `office.listDesignSystems` expose the current options.

## Headless first

Use source-first, headless generation for normal work. For example, `office.generateWebsite` creates an Open Design work order without requiring a visible design session. Use `live: true` only when a headed collaborative session is actually needed.

```json
{
  "tool": "office.generateWebsite",
  "input": {
    "name": "launch-page",
    "prompt": "Create the approved launch-page work order",
    "live": false
  }
}
```

## Validate and publish

Use browser tools to verify the rendered result. Publishing through `design.publish` or another Office publish surface is a separate action from drafting and may require explicit approval.

Office source, validation evidence, and durable links should travel together in the final handoff. [Sites](/sites/) owns the user-facing publishing model in detail.
